clips.title: The story
paras: Nissa's remains belong to a noblewoman of the once-wealthy Agamand dynasty in northern Tirisfal Glades. Slain and made mindless servants of the Scourge during the Third War, Nissa and her family are now hunted by former laborers seeking vengeance.

Before the Third War, the Agamands were Tirisfal Glades' wealthiest and most influential dynasty. Their prosperous mills stood across the northern hills. When the Plague of Undeath spread through Lordaeron, the family patriarchs refused to flee. They fortified their estates and persuaded their retainers and laborers to stay and fight. Their pride cost them their lives. The Scourge slew the Agamands, then raised them as mindless thralls bound to the Lich King's will.

In Brill, survivors who later broke free under Queen Sylvanas Windrunner still remember the Agamands' fatal pride. Coleman Farthing, once a laborer in their mills, resents his former masters for luring the workers into undeath. He charges adventurers with putting down the risen Agamands and retrieving their physical remains, including Nissa's. For Farthing and other Forsaken, destroying these relics offers a grim sense of closure and revenge.
